This 2015 Honda CR-V EX AWD is a stylish, practical, and versatile SUV that offers a great combination of comfort, convenience, and everyday functionality. Finished in the attractive Kona Coffee Metallic exterior, this CR-V has a unique and sophisticated appearance that stands out while maintaining a clean and timeless look.

The EX trim adds a nice selection of features and upgrades that make the CR-V comfortable and convenient for everyday driving. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, transporting passengers, or heading out for a weekend trip, this CR-V is designed to handle a wide variety of driving needs.

Inside, the cabin provides a comfortable and spacious environment for both the driver and passengers. The seating area offers plenty of room for everyday travel, while the elevated driving position gives the driver a good view of the road. The interior layout is straightforward and practical, with controls and features positioned conveniently for the driver.

One of the biggest advantages of the CR-V is its versatile interior. The rear seating area provides useful passenger space, while the cargo area gives you plenty of room for groceries, luggage, shopping bags, work equipment, sports gear, or other belongings. When you need additional room, the rear seats can be folded down to create a larger cargo area.

The Kona Coffee Metallic exterior gives this CR-V a distinctive look. The rich, darker finish complements the vehicle's body lines and gives it a more upscale appearance. It is a great color for someone who wants something a little different while still maintaining a sophisticated and professional look.

The all-wheel-drive (AWD) system adds another level of versatility to this CR-V. AWD can provide additional traction and confidence when driving through wet conditions or on roads where extra grip is helpful. It makes the CR-V a practical choice for drivers who want additional capability while still having a vehicle that is comfortable for everyday use.

The CR-V is also easy to maneuver, making it suitable for both city streets and highway driving. Its SUV design provides a comfortable seating position without being excessively large, making parking and navigating tighter areas relatively convenient.

The EX interior provides a nice balance between comfort and practicality. The cabin is designed to be easy to use, with useful storage areas and convenient features throughout. Whether you're making a short trip around town or spending several hours on the road, the CR-V provides a comfortable space for both the driver and passengers.

This vehicle is also well suited for different lifestyles. It can serve as a daily commuter, family vehicle, weekend adventure vehicle, or general-purpose SUV. The combination of passenger room and flexible cargo space makes it easy to adapt the vehicle to whatever your day requires.

The rear cargo area is especially useful when you need to carry larger items. With the rear seats folded, you can take advantage of the CR-V's flexible interior and create additional room for larger belongings. This makes it useful for everything from grocery runs and shopping trips to vacations and outdoor activities.

Overall, this 2015 Honda CR-V EX AWD in Kona Coffee Metallic is a well-rounded SUV with an attractive exterior, comfortable interior, flexible cargo space, and the added capability of all-wheel drive. The EX trim gives it a nice selection of comfort and convenience features while maintaining the practical nature of the CR-V.

This 2002 Chevrolet Camaro Coupe is finished in Light Pewter Metallic over Ebony cloth , showing just 63K miles—and if you've spent any time around fourth-generation Camaros, you already know why this one caught our attention. These cars were inexpensive, fun and everywhere when they were new. Most were driven hard, modified heavily, neglected, or simply used up. This one wasn't. The car was clearly garage kept and remains in exceptionally nice condition inside and out. Add in the removable T-Tops, 16" chrome wheels, 1SB Option Package, and a handful of simple upgrades , and you've got a remarkably clean example of a car that's becoming harder to find in this kind of condition. Only 63K Miles That's the headline here. 63,000 miles on a 2002 Camaro. This isn't a museum-piece collector car, and we're not going to pretend a V6 Camaro suddenly became something it wasn't. What makes this one interesting is how well it survived. The body, interior and overall presentation tell the same story as the odometer. It looks like a car that was cared for, stored properly and simply didn't accumulate the kind of mileage and abuse that claimed so many of these cars. Finding a fourth-gen Camaro isn't particularly difficult. Finding a clean 63K-mile example like this is another story entirely. T-Tops For a fourth-gen Camaro, T-Tops are almost mandatory. Pop the panels out, throw them in the back and suddenly a simple drive on a nice day becomes considerably more entertaining. They were one of the defining features of these cars when they were new, and they're still one of the first things we'd want on one today. Combined with the Light Pewter Metallic paint, chrome wheels and unmistakable fourth-gen profile, it has exactly the early-2000s Camaro look. The MagnaFlow Cat-Back Exhaust System adds some personality, the SS-style hood gives the exterior a little more attitude, and the updated lighting keeps the appearance clean without dramatically changing the original look. Inside, the Boss Audio touchscreen brings the stereo into the modern world while the rest of the cabin retains the straightforward feel that makes these cars such a nostalgia trip today. Recently Serviced This Camaro was also recently serviced and is ready to enjoy , including: Fresh Engine Oil & Filter New Fuel Filter Nothing exotic—just the kind of basic maintenance you want to see already handled on a clean older car. A Really Nice Survivor Twenty-four years has a way of separating the good ones from everything else. This Camaro doesn't need some elaborate story to make sense. It's a clean, garage-kept, 63K-mile fourth-gen with T-Tops , an attractive color combination and just enough upgrades to give it some additional personality. It's comfortable, inexpensive to own, easy to drive, and has that unmistakable late-'90s/early-2000s GM feel that you simply don't get from a modern car. Sometimes you don't need the rarest version. You just need to find a really good one. Texas Hot Rides has specialized in enthusiast, performance and specialty vehicles in the Dallas-Fort Worth area since 2009 , and we've watched clean fourth-generation Camaros become increasingly difficult to find. From V6 drivers like this one to Z28 and SS examples, condition matters—and this 63K-mile Camaro is exactly the kind of well-kept older enthusiast car we enjoy having in our Carrollton showroom. Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. Distance pacing cruise control, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The V90 Cross Country earned its reputation by proving a wagon could deliver genuine SUV-like versatility without sacrificing the low center of gravity and refined ride that make wagons so enjoyable to drive. Its raised ride height and standard all-wheel drive give it real confidence in changing weather, while its clean, understated Scandinavian design continues to set it apart from more conventional luxury SUVs. Distance pacing cruise control, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
